summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Financials ETF (RSPF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 Equal Weighted / Financials index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of financial stocks pulled from the S&P 500. RSPF was launched on Nov 1, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: RSPF is an equity ETF with a total of 79 individual holdings. The top holdings are Coinbase Global stock at 1.52%, PayPal Holdings at 1.44%, Robinhood Markets at 1.40%, Principal Financial Group at 1.39%, and Everest Group at 1.39%.
